record.title: South Ossetian H1N1 crossing closure
record.exceptions: Special-list humanitarian exits operated February 20–22, 2019; this was not a general reopening.
record.enforcement: Interfax relays Georgian First Channel reporting of reopening at 06:00 on 15 March.
record.context: Similar health closure to Abkhazia, but a separate authority and later reopening.
record.uncertainty: The contemporary announcement specifies January 11 at 20:00; Geneva co-chairs call January 12 the first day. One-direction humanitarian departures on February 20–22 interrupt a total-closure interpretation. General restoration is confirmed on March 15.
